items.headline: Bears anticipate 'great challenge' vs. Brian Flores' Vikings defense
items.description: "Coach [Ben Johnson] calls this 'mental war' when you go against versus him, and that's what it is," Bears QB Caleb Williams said of facing a Brian Flores-led defense, which Chicago will do Sunday against Minnesota.
